summary: Added a handoff order briefing so a human picking up a HANDOFF call isn't blind to an order in progress. Order.summary() (order.py) returns a compact, caller-safe list of {item, qty, size, notes} dicts using the same human-readable name fields describe() already uses (no internal ids leak). Reply gained an order_summary field (default None). Both HANDOFF-triggering branches (allergen, request_human) now go through a shared _handoff() helper that populates order_summary when self.order.lines is non-empty and appends a natural caller-facing 'I've saved your order so far...' line to reply.text; with no order in progress, behavior is unchanged. Also fixed a bug caught by the new tests: DialogSession.handle()'s multi-intent wrapper was rebuilding Reply from scratch and silently dropping order_summary before it reached the caller — now it's threaded through. Added tests/test_handoff_briefing.py (7 tests) covering both handoff paths with/without an order, multi-line orders with size/notes, no-internal-notation-leak, and non-handoff replies staying unaffected.
